env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir $WORK/bin

# A logos.toml in a subdirectory is not read: slop stays deny there.
cd misplaced
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/mis$GOEXE ./sub
stderr 'sub/main\.lgo:6:2: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
! exists $WORK/bin/mis$GOEXE
cd ..

# The capabilities table applies to a Go-only module: the default
# deny refuses the exec dependency, an allow entry lets it through.
cd gocap
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/gocap$GOEXE ./...
stderr 'capabilities::unauthorized_exec'
! exists $WORK/bin/gocap$GOEXE
cp logos-allow.toml logos.toml
logos build -o $WORK/bin/gocap$GOEXE ./...
exists $WORK/bin/gocap$GOEXE
rm logos.toml
cd ..

# Concurrency defaults to forbid: the bare go statement fails.
cd concfail
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/conc$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:6:2: \[concurrency::unsupervised_goroutine\]'
! exists $WORK/bin/conc$GOEXE
# A directive naming the forbid rule is itself an error, which a deny
# default would not report.
cd ../concdangle
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/concd$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:3:1: \[correctness::allow_forbidden_rule\]'
! exists $WORK/bin/concd$GOEXE
cd ..

# Complexity defaults to deny: five parameters exceed the default limit
# of four and fail the build.
cd complex5
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/c5$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:3:6: \[complexity::cognitive_overflow\]'
! exists $WORK/bin/c5$GOEXE
cd ..

# With cgo off, net and os/user follow the upstream CGO_ENABLED=0
# behavior: no cgo tool invocation for either package, and the binary
# builds and runs.
cd netoff
env CGO_ENABLED=1
logos build -n .
stderr 'compile'
! stderr 'importpath net'
! stderr 'importpath os/user'
logos build -o $WORK/bin/netoff$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/bin/netoff$GOEXE
stdout '^true true$'
cd ../netoffgo
env CGO_ENABLED=0
go build -n .
stderr 'compile'
! stderr 'importpath net'
! stderr 'importpath os/user'
cd ..

-- misplaced/go.mod --
module example.com/mis

go 1.27

-- misplaced/sub/main.lgo --
package main

import "os"

func main() {
	os.Remove("missing")
}

-- misplaced/sub/logos.toml --
[lints]
slop = "allow"

-- gocap/go.mod --
module example.com/gocap

go 1.27

require example.com/godep v0.0.0

replace example.com/godep => ../godep

-- gocap/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/godep"
)

func main() {
	godep.Init()
	fmt.Println("done")
}

-- gocap/logos-allow.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "allow"

-- godep/go.mod --
module example.com/godep

go 1.27

-- godep/dep.go --
package godep

import "os/exec"

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	cmd := exec.Command("echo", "hi")
	_ = cmd.Run()
}

-- concfail/go.mod --
module example.com/conc

go 1.27

-- concfail/main.lgo --
package main

func work() {}

func main() {
	go work()
}

-- concdangle/go.mod --
module example.com/concdangle

go 1.27

-- concdangle/main.lgo --
package main

//logos:allow(concurrency::unsupervised_goroutine)
func work() {}

func main() {
	work()
}

-- complex5/go.mod --
module example.com/complex5

go 1.27

-- complex5/main.lgo --
package main

func sum(a int, b int, c int, d int, e int) int {
	return a + b + c + d + e
}

func main() {
	println(sum(1, 2, 3, 4, 5))
}

-- netoff/go.mod --
module example.com/netoff

go 1.27

-- netoff/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "forbid"

-- netoff/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"os/user"
)

func main() {
	ip := net.ParseIP("127.0.0.1")
	u, err := user.Current()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(ip != nil, u.Username != "")
}

-- netoffgo/go.mod --
module example.com/netoffgo

go 1.27

-- netoffgo/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"os/user"
)

func main() {
	ip := net.ParseIP("127.0.0.1")
	u, err := user.Current()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(ip != nil, u.Username != "")
}
